[Intro]
[E5]

[Bridge]
[D5]

[Interlude]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D#5]I feel I come from
better conditions
Buried deep in my
mind I forgot
Awake
my soul
I want to
find and drink this
light

[Bridge]
[D5]
Images
of the past
Other lives and o-
ther places
Always the
same embraces
I return to
where I've been

[Interlude]
[D5]

[Verse 2]
[D#5]I take inside a
forward movement
Involved in de-
sire of consciousness
Progress,
understand
I want to
find the keys of
past

[Bridge]
[D5]

[Interlude]
[D5]

[Bridge]
[D5]
[F#5]
[G5]

[Verse 3]
[D5]Remember the past
present future
Memory is force
So many things have
happened
To me the
hardest of all
But the gates would
never again
Be opened
to me unless
I could bid them
open at my
Own will and com-
mand

[Verse 4]
[D5]I feel I come
from
better con-
ditions

[Bridge]
[D5]Opened them at
my own
will and com-
mand

[Verse 5]
[F#5]Buried deep
in
[G5]my mind I
forgot

[Bridge]
[A5/E]Opened them at
my own
will and com-
mand

[Verse 6]
[F#5]Always the same
light,
[G5]same em-
braces

[Bridge]
[A5/E]Opened them at
my own
will and com-
mand

[Verse 7]
[F#5]I take inside
a
[G5]forward
movement

[Outro]
[D5]
